films.title: The Isdal Woman
films.subtitle: The Woman Who Erased Her Own Identity
films.description: In November 1970, a burned body was found in Norway's Isdalen valley. Her fingerprints were filed away, her labels were cut from her clothes, and her identity remains unknown more than five decades later. A sourced, evidence-first documentary.

films.title: The Ostrich, Engraved
films.subtitle: One plate, one build — a copperplate natural-history short
films.description: A 58-second copperplate-engraving film: the ostrich drawn as a living plate — burin cuts, three hatch passes, the amber iris wash, and the finished print. Original release lost in account migration; method preserved in BRAIN.md and burin engine partially recovered in tool-results/.
